messages:
Maria (oncall): hey — quick follow-up from last night's SLO incident. i think we keep losing momentum between the live mitigation and the actual postmortem. can we try a super short 'rapid pm standup' template to capture impact + immediate actions within 5 minutes? :wave:
Ajay (eng-sre): +1. something we can run right after incident close. minimal fields, auto-populated metadata. the key is: incident id, customer impact summary (1-2 lines), root-candidate, immediate mitigation done, 3 next actions (owner + eta).
Sophia (prod-reliability): love that. also include a quick checkbox for 'needs customer comms' and 'hotfix required' so we can triage on the spot.
Maria (oncall): exactly. thinking flow: IncidentBot posts auto-fill, oncall edits freeform answers, then it creates action items in the action dashboard and optionally opens a ticket in our tracker.
Ajay (eng-sre): prototype template (very small):
```
Rapid PM Standup v0.1
- incident: {{INC_ID}}
- time window: {{start}} - {{end}}
- customer-impact: 1-2 lines
- severity: P1/P2/P3
- mitigation summary: 1 line
- root-candidate: 1 line
- immediate actions: owner / ETA / short description (up to 3)
- need-customer-comms: yes/no
- followup-intended: quick postmortem / full postmortem
```
Ajay (eng-sre): IncidentBot could fill {{INC_ID}}, {{start}}, {{end}}, participants from the PD incident, and even pre-suggest root-candidates from alert signature tags.
Eve (manager): minor ask — make it optional to expand to a full template. don't force a full PM if it's a transient bla that only needs 1 action. noise is real. :thinking_face:
Sophia (prod-reliability): agreed. two modes: 'rapid' for immediate action & triage; 'full' for when we need a deeper writeup. the bot should add a quick link to the Redwood Console metrics slices for that incident window.
Ajay (eng-sre): draft of the slash command/flow: `/rapid-pm create --incident INC-904 --mode rapid` -> posts ephemeral form to oncall -> once submitted: creates entry in Action Dashboard, posts summary to #incidents, optionally opens tracker ticket.
Maria (oncall): can the bot auto-assign the first action to whoever acknowledged the incident? that's usually the person who did the live mitigation. saves time.
Ajay (eng-sre): yes, we can map PD responder -> github/jira user with our identity map. fallback to rotation owner if mapping not present.
OpsBot: Incident INC-904 status changed to CLOSED by Maria. Detected responders: Maria (oncall), Ajay (eng-sre). Would you like to run a Rapid PM Standup? (react with :white_check_mark: to auto-run)
Maria (oncall): reacted :white_check_mark:
Sophia (prod-reliability): minor UI thought — let the oncall edit the fields inline in Slack modal + markdown area. then add a short audit log of edits. helps when handoffs happen.
Eve (manager): also add a fast 'customer impact blurb' template for support to copy into outbound comms. one-liner + recommended time-window for followup.
Ajay (eng-sre): sample modal payload (sketch):
```
{
  incident: "INC-904",
  impact: "API 502s for 12m affecting onboarding flow (~2% of requests)",
  mitigation: "scaled dedicated pool, rolled back deploy",
  immediate_actions: ["create hotfix branch - Ajay - 2h", "confirm cache TTL - Maria - 1d"],
  followup: "full postmortem if customer-impact > 1% or recurring"
}
```
Ajay (eng-sre): (note: bot payload above is just a sketch — actual storage will be in the action dashboard rows, not nested JSON in Slack message)
Maria (oncall): how do we avoid flooding #incidents with small ones? maybe bot posts to #incidents only when followup is 'full' or when customer-impact flagged. otherwise post summary to a quieter log channel and link it in the incident.
Sophia (prod-reliability): yep, default: quiet-log + link to dashboard. bump to #incidents if severity >= P2 or customer-impact yes.
Eve (manager): what about oncall handoffs? can the bot attach the rapid pm summary into the handoff message so the next oncall sees context immediately?
Ajay (eng-sre): absolutely — we can append `rapid_pm_summary` to the handoff doc and include action items as TODOs. also expose a `/rapid-pm list --open` for the handoff person.
Maria (oncall): ops detail: can we surface who did the live mitigation (concrete command/timestamp)? that helps during triage when owners say 'i didn't do that' vs proof of action.
Ajay (eng-sre): capture mitigation lines as a short code block in the modal. e.g.:
```
mitigation commands:
- `kubectl scale deployment api --replicas=10` - Maria - 2026-03-10T22:13Z
- `revert commit a1b2c3` - Ajay - 2026-03-10T22:18Z
```
Sophia (prod-reliability): for the action dashboard: key dims = incident id, owner, status, ETA, followup-type, link-to-console-slice, customer-impact-boolean. we can surface a 'stale actions' widget for overdue ETAs.
Eve (manager): timeline for an MVP? can we have a basic modal + create-action integration in 2 sprints?
Ajay (eng-sre): yes, 2 sprints for minimal: slash cmd, modal, action dashboard row creation, and PD/GH mapping. 3rd sprint for handoff integration + metrics link.
Maria (oncall): tests we should add: simulate multiple incidents in 1 night, make sure only one rapid-pm per incident and dedupe. also ensure rate limit so we don't spam oncall when noise.
Sophia (prod-reliability): small UX ask: let the modal pre-fill recommended owners based on the alert routing table. saves typing.
Ajay (eng-sre): noted. I'll put a prototype in a branch and post a demo gif.
OpsBot: Rapid PM Standup created: https://redwood.internal/dashboard/actions/rapid-pm/INC-904 (summary posted to #quiet-incident-log)
Maria (oncall): ok looks good. action items: Ajay -> prototype modal + slash cmd (ETA: 2w), Sophia -> dashboard widget mockups (ETA: 1w), Eve -> stakeholder comms plan for rollout (ETA: 1w). i can follow up with a quick meeting if needed.
Eve (manager): agree. pls add those as Jira tasks and tag me.
Ajay (eng-sre): will do. posting initial PR link when ready.
Maria (oncall): thanks everyone. if anyone wants to join prototyping pm later today ping me. :thumbsup:
